features.feature: Before old-dist eviction, promoteDist validates and restores every declared staging bin target: POSIX gains executable mode bits and Windows preserves the byte-identical Node entrypoint used by npm command shims, with a platform-invariant contract selector.
Promotion failure keeps the working dist intact; missing targets are benign while non-files, final symlinks, and intermediate-directory symlink escapes are rejected before chmod or eviction.
The registered executable regression remains discriminating against the unfixed baseline and exposes a stable global-cli-bin-target-restored marker across POSIX and Windows branches.
Doctor reports resolved realpath, compiled version, observed mode and executable state through a host-independent passing marker rather than a checkout-specific absolute selector.

Doctor remains read-only and emits exact host-shell remediation: POSIX uses executable-mode commands, while Windows uses cmd.exe-valid quoting, cd /d, dir inspection, npm rebuild and npm-link commands without prescribing chmod.

The RI-005 repair commit 1e1e346043 changes only runtime-environment-checks.ts, global-core-realpath.test.mjs, and red-global-cli-exec-bit.mjs; all three are already declared CHK-001 or CHK-003 implementation/test surfaces and address F-024, F-026, F-027 and F-028 without adding a new product surface.

Do not change Codex adapter entrypoint authority, npm link or global-install mechanics, or protected build-lock/crash-safety behavior; diagnostic remediation text may describe npm link but does not automate or alter installation.

All PLAN truth sources use the same cross-platform contract. Current understanding.json still states an unqualified 0755 outcome, and plan.md still presents ls -la and chmod-based verification/remediation without the POSIX-only qualification now present in CHK-001, CHK-003 and ProofStory AC-001.

openQuestions.q: Should the corrected CHK-001 and CHK-003 verification intents plus ProofStory AC-001 explicitly supersede the remaining unqualified POSIX examples in understanding.json and plan.md, or must those planning artifacts be reworded before DEV?
openQuestions.evidence: understanding.json.outcome says dist/cli.js has mode 0755 without a POSIX qualifier, and plan.md verification/remediation uses ls -la and chmod +x generically; current checklist.json and proofstory.json instead define POSIX executable bits versus Windows npm command-shim semantics and cmd.exe-valid remediation.
openQuestions.resolution: The planning artifacts must be reworded rather than treating the corrected checklist as an implicit supersession. Commit e5a5e83c87 now states the POSIX executable-bit contract and the Windows npm-shim/cmd.exe contract explicitly in both understanding.json and plan.md, matching CHK-001, CHK-003, and ProofStory AC-001.
